description: Land Acquisition - Heenapahuwa, Wellawaya D/S Division, Monaragala District (Section 05)
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for a water treatment plant project. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the land acquisition declaration and does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
